USMLE-style practice · Pharmacology

Quantal response

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

Investigators administer increasing doses of an analgesic to different groups of patients. For each patient, the outcome is recorded only as whether a predefined pain-relief threshold was reached. Which type of dose–response measurement is being collected?

  1. Quantal response
  2. Graded response in a single tissue
  3. A direct measure of plasma clearance
  4. A receptor-binding dissociation constant
  5. A volume-of-distribution measurement
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Quantal response

A quantal endpoint records whether a specified effect occurs in each individual.

Understanding the options

Quantal response
A quantal endpoint records whether a specified effect occurs in each individual.
Graded response in a single tissue
The endpoint is yes/no across individuals rather than response magnitude in one preparation.
A direct measure of plasma clearance
The study records an effect, not elimination.
A receptor-binding dissociation constant
Clinical yes/no response does not directly measure binding affinity.
A volume-of-distribution measurement
No body amount-to-plasma concentration ratio is measured.
